title: Teacher Salary SA: Hourly to Annual Conversion with Casual Loading and Super
description: Calculate your teacher salary SA from hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, and take-home pay. Includes casual loading, super, and tax estimates for 2026-27.
salarySummary: This guide uses a standard 38-hour week to convert your hourly rate to annual gross pay, then estimates tax and super contributions.

faqs.q: How does casual loading affect my teacher salary SA calculation?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an additional 25% on top of the base hourly rate, as per Fair Work Ombudsman. For example, if your base rate is $30, casual loading brings it to $37.50. Super is calculated on the total ordinary earnings including loading.

faqs.q: What is the super guarantee rate for 2026-27?
faqs.a: The super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. It applies up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For a teacher salary SA, ensure your employer pays this.

faqs.q: How do I estimate my take-home pay from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by 38 hours per week and 52 weeks for annual gross. Then apply the 2026-27 tax brackets and 2% Medicare levy. The result is your estimated annual net pay. Use our take-home pay guide for more details.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly to Annual Pay

To convert an hourly rate to annual gross pay, use the formula: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52**. This guide assumes a standard 38-hour week, which is the full-time benchmark under the National Employment Standards. For example, an hourly rate of $30 gives:

- Weekly: $30 × 38 = $1,140
- Fortnightly: $1,140 × 2 = $2,280
- Annual: $1,140 × 52 = $59,280

If you work different hours, adjust accordingly. The [timesheet](/) on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate and see the annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures instantly.

## Understanding Casual Loading

Casual loading is a 25% addition to the base hourly rate, compensating for lack of paid leave. The Fair Work Ombudsman sets this as a minimum for most awards. When researching **teacher salary SA**, note that casual teachers often receive this loading on top of their base award rate. For instance, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour; with casual loading it becomes $33.05 per hour. Super is paid on the total ordinary earnings, including the loading. Use the [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page to see how this affects your pay.

### Award Rates vs Minimum Wage

The National Minimum Wage is a floor, but many awards—including those covering teachers—set higher minimum rates. The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes award pay guides. For a teacher salary SA, check the relevant state or federal award. The figures here are estimates; your actual rate may differ.

## Superannuation and Tax

Super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. It applies up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. For the example above ($59,280 annual), super would be $59,280 × 12% = $7,113.60, making total employment cost $66,393.60. See [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) for more.

Tax for 2026-27 uses the resident scale:
- Nil on first $18,200
- 15% on $18,201–$45,000
- 30% on $45,001–$135,000
- 37% on $135,001–$190,000
- 45% above $190,000
Plus 2% Medicare levy (using 2025-26 single reduction thresholds). For $59,280 annual, tax would be approximately $8,717 plus Medicare $1,185.60, leaving net around $49,377.40. This is an estimate; use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for your exact situation.

## Average Earnings in South Australia

The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports average weekly ordinary time earnings for full-time adults in South Australia as $1,970.20 per week (May 2026). This is an average across all industries and occupations, not a median for teachers. When comparing a teacher salary SA, remember that averages can be skewed by high earners. For personalised figures, refer to the [average pay](/topics/average-pay) page.

## Important Notes

- The conversion assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice.
- Casual loading is added via a checkbox on the [timesheet](/)—do not enter a rate that already includes loading.
- Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base.
- Tax uses the 2026-27 resident scale with full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 thresholds were not confirmed here.
- HELP, Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted.
- This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

For further reading, explore the [reference tables](/data) or [pay guides](/blog).
